Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete explicit compiler and declaration callbacks reviewed. Consensus
positivity is keyed by claim cell; individual source/context governs declaration pairing
and refutation. Refutations match source/context/type/object, without timestamp precedence
in this helper. same_inputs compares identity membership and the union of origins, not
ordered operands, multiplicity or per-operand origin correspondence. Generic task-shape
compilation is a separate caller branch.
